## Statement · **draft**
Let a group $G$ act on a set $X$ and let $x \in X$. The set

$G_x := \operatorname{Stab}(x) := \{\, g \in G : g \cdot x = x \,\} \le G$

is the **stabilizer** of $x$ (or isotropy subgroup).
